infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Afterglow uses your location only to notice when you leave a place and to show nearby residue. It does not show who is here.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Afterglow records an 8–12 second voice note only after you start recording.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Afterglow takes a still photo you choose to leave. A face is not required.
